Name: Sushant Vijayan
Bio:
Dr Sushant Vijayan is a Visiting Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence major at Plaksha. His research focuses on sequential decision-making problems and differential games.

Prior to joining Plaksha, Dr Sushant completed his PhD from the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai. He holds an MSc in Applications of Mathematics from Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) and a BTech in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Madras. He has also held roles at Google DeepMind, Credit Suisse, Volvo, and Pentair Valves.
Education: Phd, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research | MSc, Chennai Mathematical Institute | BTech, IIT Madras
Research_Interests: Bandits | Differential Games | Applied Probability | Reinforcement Learning
